resources.string: Send a Leqi command after each step. Expected callbacks: A → B → B → neither.\nSwipe to select, click to run. Keep this page in the foreground.

[Guide] Only one interceptor can be active. Register B replaces A. Unregister A must preserve B. The expected owner reflects local operations, not an SDK status query. Use actual callbacks (eventCode=11000) to verify; silence alone does not prove an event was generated.
[Page] Foreground; press Register A or B to start. Returning does not restore registration. Leaving unregisters both objects; counters last for this page instance.
[Operation %1$s] %2$s (%3$s) returned; expected=%4$s. Verify with a new command.
[Callback %1$s] count=%2$d; expected at arrival=%3$s; page foreground=%4$s; extra=%5$s
